claims.text: titles: Ideen I (cách gọi tắt của Ideen zu einer reinen Phänomenologie und phänomenologischen Philosophie. Erstes Buch)

sources.quote: Husserliana 3, 1–2: Ideen zu einer reinen Phänomenologie und phänomenologischen Philosophie. Erstes Buch
(commonly referred to as Ideas I) from 1913
his next major work Ideas Pertaining to a Pure Phenomenology and to a Phenomenological Philosophy I
Ideas I from 1913 marks Husserl’s explicit embrace of transcendental philosophy
